analyst.summary: Coromandel International, the Murugappa Group's fertiliser and crop-protection major, grew FY26 revenue by roughly 30% but reported PAT fell 8% - a swing driven almost entirely by a one-off FY25 land-sale gain reversing into a small FY26 impairment charge, which masks a real but separate margin compression (EBITDA margin down to ~10% from ~12%) from higher phosphoric-acid/sulphur costs. At roughly 31x trailing earnings the stock is priced for stronger EPS growth than its own 3-year profit trend (-1% CAGR) has delivered; Q1 FY27 numbers are due 23-Jul-2026, two days out. We rate it Hold: a solid, well-run franchise with genuine diversification underway, but a valuation that is ahead of the earnings evidence.
